entries.title: More Relevant Sources, Clearer Limits
entries.description: Luca now sets aside weakly-matched sources so answers lean on genuinely relevant material instead of loosely-related filler. And when your filters—libraries, media types, or a focused source or author—leave nothing to match, Luca tells you exactly which filter is limiting the results and suggests broadening it, rather than guessing or inventing quotes.

entries.title: Auto (recommended) Author Selection
entries.description: Luca now defaults to Auto (recommended) in the author filter. For each question, Luca finds the most relevant sources across all authors, with a gentle preference for Master and Swami when that fits. Mention a teacher by name—such as Asha—and Luca focuses on that author. You can still choose Master and Swami or All authors from the filter anytime.

entries.title: Source Focus
entries.description: You can now focus Luca on a single source, such as a book, chapter, or source family. Choose a source before asking, or click "Focus on this source" after an answer, and Luca will stay focused there until you clear it.

entries.title: More Task Wizards and Streamlined Tools
entries.description: We now have seven task wizards to help you create comprehensive queries. The wizards will help you get started and suggest follow-up tasks to go even further. Click the magic wand in the question input box to get started.

entries.title: Beginner Zoom Session Recordings
entries.description: Recordings of the beginner Zoom sessions are now available. These recordings provide valuable guidance for those new to Luca.

entries.title: Task Wizard
entries.description: New structured task wizards help you create comprehensive research queries and class plans. Click the task buttons above the chat input to get started. The wizards will help you get started and suggest follow-up tasks to go even further.

entries.title: What's New Feature
entries.description: Stay updated with the latest features and improvements. Click the bell icon in the top right button bar to see recent updates.

entries.title: AI Model Selection
entries.description: You can now choose the underlying AI model that generates the answers. Different AI models have different strengths - some are faster, others are more thorough. Different models may interpret questions differently. Some models excel at creative responses, others at factual accuracy. You can experiment to find which model works best for your needs.
